issue.title: Prove the five-scenario Issue to Tactus–Ictus–Dagster vertical slice
issue.body:
## Objective

Demonstrate one persistent end-to-end control/decision/execution path with no duplicate unsafe execution after restart.

## Architecture owner

Cross-system

## Context

KEEP + MODIFY of #12. Reconcile FIX-009 waiting-for-FIX-008 provenance; do not duplicate or automatically resume those existing WorkOrders.

Architecture Baseline v1 was adopted through [Tactus PR #19](https://github.com/Walsamer/tactus/pull/19) and [Ictus PR #1](https://github.com/Walsamer/ictus/pull/1).
Current implementation is evidence; the merged baseline specifies the target.

## Scope

Tactus composition/integration fixtures, local Dagster code location and deterministic subprocess capability, end-to-end scenario runner and evidence documentation. Pin Ictus dependency to reviewed commits.

## Non-goals

No unrelated feature work, authority transfer, direct main mutation or deployment.

## Interfaces / contracts

Inputs: Checked GitHub Issue fixture and source revision, local context/policy/backend facts.

Outputs: Verified WorkOrder outcome, run correlation and persisted artifacts for five scenarios.

Owned state: Tactus composition and domain application; no new policy implementation.

External state: Ictus decisions, Dagster execution, local subprocess facts.

## Dependencies

- https://github.com/Walsamer/tactus/issues/8
- https://github.com/Walsamer/tactus/issues/21
- https://github.com/Walsamer/ictus/issues/6

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Success: Issue → WO → initial snapshot → allowed intent → independently launched Dagster run → subprocess → verified IMPLEMENTED.
- [ ] Transient failure: Dagster step retry succeeds without increasing semantic-attempt count.
- [ ] Semantic/backend failure: normalized observation → Ictus RecoveryDecision → Tactus authorized effect; no runtime fallback policy.
- [ ] Irrecoverable/ambiguous case persists human escalation across restart and accepts only valid typed resolution.
- [ ] Crash at dispatch/ack/result application and duplicate delivery produce one authorized side effect and one domain application.
- [ ] Evidence includes source hash, snapshot/decision/intent/attempt/run IDs and assertions for denied/stale/late inputs; Pi/Stax/Metaxy/OpenShell/Kubernetes absent from prerequisites.

## Verification

Add and document one reproducible scenario-runner command using temporary SQLite/DAGSTER_HOME/workspace roots. Run all five scenarios plus uv run pytest, scripts/verify-goal.sh and the pinned Ictus gate.

## Architecture references

- https://github.com/Walsamer/tactus/blob/main/docs/architecture/SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md
- https://github.com/Walsamer/tactus/blob/main/docs/architecture/CROSS_SYSTEM_CONTRACTS.md
- https://github.com/Walsamer/tactus/blob/main/docs/architecture/EXECUTION_AND_RECOVERY.md
- https://github.com/Walsamer/tactus/blob/main/docs/architecture/MIGRATION_FROM_FLEET.md
- https://github.com/Walsamer/ictus/blob/main/docs/architecture/BASELINE_V1.md

## Execution handoff

Fleet intake is blocked until https://github.com/Walsamer/tactus/issues/20 is complete, project mapping/configuration is approved, and the dependencies above are satisfied. A human may implement after implementation dependencies complete, with explicit assignment to avoid overlap.

GitHub Issue = shared implementation intent. Derived WorkOrders must preserve
repository/Issue URL/number/title, source revision, import timestamp and source
body/specification hash. One Issue may yield several bounded WorkOrders. Only
`fleet:ready` authorizes intake; an open Issue or milestone does not. Do not
silently execute a changed specification or revive superseded legacy WorkOrders.
